claim_updates.reason: Plug-in KL estimator D_KL(P(Y|Z,A)||P(Y|Z)) with Laplace smoothing alpha in {0, 0.01, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0} is REJECTED for simultaneous C1 null centering (|shuffled-action null_mean|<0.1 bits) and C3 sensitivity (positive_control_k3>=0.5 bits) on the stochastic 12-state SPA at N=5000. The tradeoff is monotonic and irreconcilable: alpha=0 achieves K3=1.377 bits but |null_mean|=0.924 (9.2x threshold); alpha=1.0 achieves |null_mean|=0.064 but K3=0.099 (5.1x below threshold). No crossover exists in the tested alpha range. This falsifies only the hyperparameter-tuned plug-in KL pathway on this discrete sparse-data SPA class (avg 1.48 records per (z,a) cell). Audit REVISE status accepted: methodological findings (C1 stratification mismatch between K2/K3, deterministic baseline identifiability gap, sparse strata coverage 26.4% below 30% threshold) are disclosed but do not change the FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING verdict (priority rule: FALSIFIED > MEASUREMENT_INVALID).

No new evidence for or against predictive dynamical structure on real Web transitions. This experiment tests estimator sensitivity on a synthetic 12-state SPA, not Web dynamics. The frozen FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING verdict closes only the plug-in KL alpha sweep pathway on this SPA class.

next_question: Can entropy-rate estimation (H(Y|Z,A) vs H(Y|Z) without per-stratum KL weighting) or Bayesian model comparison detect the 1.52-bit CMI signal on the stochastic 12-state SPA while maintaining null centering, thereby bypassing the plug-in KL bias-variance tradeoff?
reason: Frozen FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING triggered by C3: the only alpha passing C1 (alpha=1.0, |null_mean|=0.064) has positive_control_k3=0.099 < 0.5 bits. The sensitivity-null tradeoff is monotonic (K3 increases 13.9x from 0.099 to 1.377 while |null_mean| increases 14.4x from 0.064 to 0.924 as alpha decreases from 1.0 to 0). Audit PASS on measurement validity; audit REVISE on four methodological disclosures (C1 stratification K2 vs K3 mismatch, B-DETERMINISTIC-SPA identifiability gap, sparse strata 26.4% coverage, missing baselines B-PERMUTATION-TEST/B-PARENT-KSG-K5/B-KSG-CMI-K10). Audit recomputes match producer. Parent EXP-PHYSICS-35510154353 established audit MLE alpha=0 K3=1.377 and alpha=0.1 K3=0.743; this experiment confirms those values and adds null_mean measurements showing the crossover does not exist. The plug-in KL estimator class with Laplace smoothing is exhausted on this SPA class. Orthogonal estimator paradigms are the required next attack.
